about:
Kapital Electric, Inc. is a locally owned and operated renewable energy contractor based in Bensenville, Illinois. Founded in 2009, the company has served the Chicago metropolitan area, Northwest Indiana, and Northern Illinois for over a decade.

The firm specializes in turnkey solar photovoltaic installations, electric vehicle charger deployment, battery storage systems, and virtual power plant integration. Its service portfolio also includes ice-melting equipment installation, smart home automation, and electrical service upgrades. Kapital Electric manages the full project lifecycle — from free onsite evaluation and permitting through inspection and commissioning — and offers 24-hour emergency support for solar customers.

The company works with both residential and commercial clients. Homeowners in the Chicagoland suburbs engage Kapital Electric for rooftop arrays, garage EV chargers, and whole-house battery backup. Commercial customers include businesses seeking to offset energy costs with solar and storage. The firm’s project references cite installations for individual condos, single-family homes, and commercial facilities across DeKalb County and the broader region.

Kapital Electric distinguishes itself by using American-made solar panels, handling all permitting and inspections in-house, and providing free estimates. The company emphasizes ownership over leasing to capture federal and state tax incentives, and it promotes a straightforward installation process backed by a 24-hour emergency service line for solar customers.
